description: This file contains a Smarty template engine plugin, specifically a {fetch} function that fetches data from files, URLs, or FTP resources, and displays or assigns the fetched content.

methods.name: smarty_function_fetch
methods.description: Function to fetch content from a file, URL, or FTP resource based on the provided parameters. Handles HTTP fetching with headers, proxy, and security policy checks, and assigns the result to a template variable or returns it.
